blocks.zh: 前言、導論、範圍與術語定義 — 醫療器械品質管理系統的規範框架
blocks.en: Foreword, Introduction, Scope and Terms — The Normative Framework for Medical Device Quality Management Systems

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 ISO 13485:2016 的標準定位：它不是 ISO 9001 的子集，而是專為醫療器械法規目的設計的獨立標準
blocks.en: Understand where ISO 13485:2016 stands: it is not a subset of ISO 9001, but an independent standard designed for medical device regulatory purposes

blocks.zh: 掌握 0.2 概念澄清的關鍵語言慣例：「shall」是要求、「should」是建議、「documented」意味著建立+實施+維護
blocks.en: Master the key language conventions clarified in 0.2: "shall" is a requirement, "should" is a recommendation, and "documented" means established + implemented + maintained

blocks.zh: 理解標準範圍的邊界：適用於生命週期各階段的組織，包括 CDMO 等製造服務提供者
blocks.en: Understand the boundaries of the scope: the standard applies to organizations at any stage of the life cycle, including manufacturing service providers such as CDMOs

blocks.zh: 熟悉 22 個核心術語（3.1–3.20），特別是 advisory notice、manufacturer、medical device、risk、sterile medical device
blocks.en: Become familiar with the 22 core terms (3.1–3.20), especially advisory notice, manufacturer, medical device, risk and sterile medical device

blocks.zh: 能在客戶稽核和技術轉移討論中正確使用 ISO 13485 術語，避免與 ISO 9001 術語混淆
blocks.en: Use ISO 13485 terminology correctly in customer audits and technology transfer discussions, and avoid confusing it with ISO 9001 terminology

blocks.zh: Foreword — ISO 13485:2016 的發展脈絡
blocks.en: Foreword — The Development Background of ISO 13485:2016

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 概念解析：ISO/TC 210 的職責
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: The Responsibilities of ISO/TC 210

blocks.zh: ISO/TC 210（Technical Committee 210）專門負責「醫療器械品質管理及相關通用方面」的國際標準。與製造注射裝置的 TC 84 不同，TC 210 的焦點是整個醫療器械行業的品質管理系統架構。
blocks.en: ISO/TC 210 (Technical Committee 210) is responsible for international standards on "quality management and corresponding general aspects for medical devices". Unlike TC 84, which deals with injection devices, TC 210 focuses on the quality management system architecture of the medical device industry as a whole.

blocks.zh: 第三版（2016）的主要變化：
blocks.en: Main changes in the third edition (2016):

blocks.zh: 整合了 ISO/TR 14969:2004（實施指引文件）的內容
blocks.en: It incorporates the content of ISO/TR 14969:2004 (the implementation guidance document)

blocks.zh: 更強化了風險導向方法的要求（risk-based approach 出現在多個條款）
blocks.en: It strengthens the requirements for a risk-based approach (the risk-based approach appears in several clauses)

blocks.zh: 更明確要求組織文件化自身在法規要求下的角色（manufacturer / authorized representative / importer / distributor）
blocks.en: It more explicitly requires the organization to document its own role under the applicable regulatory requirements (manufacturer / authorized representative / importer / distributor)

blocks.zh: 新增外包流程控制要求（4.1.5），要求書面品質協議
blocks.en: It adds requirements for the control of outsourced processes (4.1.5), including written quality agreements

blocks.zh: 重點提示：2003 版 vs. 2016 版
blocks.en: Key Point: 2003 Edition vs. 2016 Edition

blocks.zh: 若客戶的 QMS 認證是基於 2003 版，需注意以下升版差異：
blocks.en: If a customer's QMS certification is based on the 2003 edition, note the following differences on upgrading:

blocks.zh: 2016 版新增 4.1.6：QMS 軟體驗證（電子批次記錄、ERP 系統等需驗證）
blocks.en: The 2016 edition adds 4.1.6: validation of QMS software (electronic batch records, ERP systems, etc. must be validated)

blocks.zh: 2016 版明確要求 Medical Device File（4.2.3）為獨立文件要求（2003 版無此明確條款）
blocks.en: The 2016 edition explicitly requires the Medical Device File (4.2.3) as a stand-alone documentation requirement (the 2003 edition had no such explicit clause)

blocks.zh: 5.6.2 管理審查輸入新增「適用的新法規要求」作為必要輸入項目
blocks.en: 5.6.2 adds "new or revised regulatory requirements" as a mandatory input to management review

blocks.zh: ISO/TR 14969（實施指引）已廢止，其精神整合進正文
blocks.en: ISO/TR 14969 (the implementation guidance) has been withdrawn, and its intent has been integrated into the main text

blocks.zh: Introduction 0.1 — 一般說明：標準的設計意圖
blocks.en: Introduction 0.1 — General: The Design Intent of the Standard

blocks.zh: 概念解析：ISO 13485 的適用範圍遠比你以為的廣
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: The Scope of ISO 13485 Is Much Broader Than You Think

blocks.zh: 標準明確點名適用於「生命週期一個或多個階段」——這意味著：
blocks.en: The standard explicitly states that it applies to organizations involved in "one or more stages of the life cycle", which means:

blocks.zh: 設計開發階段（研發公司）
blocks.en: Design and development (R&D companies)

blocks.zh: 生產階段（製造商、CDMO）
blocks.en: Production (manufacturers, CDMOs)

blocks.zh: 儲存與配送（3PL/倉儲業者）
blocks.en: Storage and distribution (3PL / warehousing providers)

blocks.zh: 安裝與服務（設備供應商）
blocks.en: Installation and servicing (equipment suppliers)

blocks.zh: 原料/元件/滅菌服務供應商（第二層供應鏈）
blocks.en: Suppliers of raw materials / components / sterilization services (second-tier supply chain)

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，ISO 13485 認證既是客戶的要求（supply chain audit），也是進入高端市場（歐盟 CE/MDR、美國 FDA QSR）的通行證。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, ISO 13485 certification is both a customer requirement (supply chain audit) and a passport to high-end markets (EU CE marking/MDR, US FDA QSR).

blocks.zh: 類比說明：角色識別的重要性
blocks.en: Analogy: Why Identifying Your Role Matters

blocks.zh: 標準要求組織「識別自己在適用法規下的角色」。這就像申請食品許可前必須先確定：你是「食品製造商」、「食品分裝業者」、還是「代工生產者」？每個角色對應不同的法規義務。
blocks.en: The standard requires the organization to "identify its role under the applicable regulatory requirements". It is like applying for a food license: you must first determine whether you are a "food manufacturer", a "food repackager" or a "contract producer". Each role carries different regulatory obligations.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在不同客戶關係中可能同時扮演：
blocks.en: A CDMO may play several roles at once across different customer relationships:

blocks.zh: CMO（Contract Manufacturing Organization）→ 製造商（Manufacturer）角色
blocks.en: CMO (Contract Manufacturing Organization) → Manufacturer role

blocks.zh: 滅菌服務提供者 → 外包服務提供者角色
blocks.en: Sterilization service provider → outsourced service provider role

blocks.zh: 元件供應商 → 供應商角色
blocks.en: Component supplier → supplier role

blocks.zh: 每個角色對應不同的 QMS 文件和法規義務，必須在 QMS 範疇聲明中明確區分。
blocks.en: Each role corresponds to different QMS documentation and regulatory obligations, and they must be clearly distinguished in the QMS scope statement.

blocks.zh: Introduction 0.2–0.5 — 概念澄清、流程方法與和 ISO 9001 的關係
blocks.en: Introduction 0.2–0.5 — Clarification of Concepts, Process Approach and Relationship with ISO 9001

blocks.zh: 概念解析："documented" 的三重含義
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: The Three Meanings of "documented"

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 中「documented」是一個重量級詞彙，稽核員對此特別敏感。標準明確說明：
blocks.en: In ISO 13485, "documented" is a heavyweight word, and auditors are particularly sensitive to it. The standard states explicitly:

blocks.zh: documented = established（建立）+ implemented（實施）+ maintained（維護）
blocks.en: documented = established + implemented + maintained

blocks.zh: 實務含義：若條款要求你有一個「documented procedure」，稽核員不只是要看到一份 SOP 文件，他還會問：
blocks.en: In practice: if a clause requires a "documented procedure", the auditor does not just want to see an SOP. He or she will also ask:

blocks.zh: 這個程序是否有正式批准（established）？
blocks.en: Has the procedure been formally approved (established)?

blocks.zh: 員工是否按照這個程序執行（implemented）？
blocks.en: Do employees actually follow the procedure (implemented)?

blocks.zh: 文件是否定期審查更新（maintained）？
blocks.en: Is the document reviewed and updated periodically (maintained)?

blocks.zh: 三個條件缺一不可。
blocks.en: All three conditions must be met; none can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 類比說明："shall" vs. "should" 的實務意義
blocks.en: Analogy: The Practical Meaning of "shall" vs. "should"

blocks.zh: 在 ISO 標準語言中，這個區別至關重要：
blocks.en: In the language of ISO standards, this distinction is critical:

blocks.zh: "shall"（要求）：就像法律條文的「應…」——稽核不符合就是缺失（nonconformity）。
blocks.en: "shall" (requirement): like "must" in a legal text, failing to comply in an audit is a nonconformity.

blocks.zh: "should"（建議）：就像法律的「宜…」——不遵從可以，但需要有合理說明。
blocks.en: "should" (recommendation): like "ought to" in a legal text, non-compliance is possible, but a reasonable justification is needed.

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 的 "shall" 密度比 ISO 9001 高得多，這反映了醫療器械行業的法規強制性本質。面對稽核員時，能清楚區分 shall/should 的工程師顯得更有專業素養。
blocks.en: ISO 13485 has a much higher density of "shall" than ISO 9001, which reflects the mandatory regulatory nature of the medical device industry. An engineer who can clearly distinguish shall from should comes across as more professional in front of auditors.

blocks.zh: 實務思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 客戶要求 CDMO 提供 ISO 13485 認證。某同事說「我們有 ISO 9001 認證，應該也算符合 ISO 13485 吧？」根據 0.4 節，這個說法是否正確？為什麼？
blocks.en: A customer asks a CDMO to provide ISO 13485 certification. A colleague says, "We have ISO 9001 certification, so that should count as ISO 13485 compliance too." According to clause 0.4, is this statement correct? Why?

blocks.zh: QMS 文件中有一條程序使用了 "should review annually"（建議每年審查）。如果稽核員發現已三年未審查，這是否構成 nonconformity？
blocks.en: A procedure in the QMS documentation uses the wording "should review annually". If an auditor finds that it has not been reviewed for three years, does this constitute a nonconformity?

blocks.zh: CDMO 承接了一個滅菌外包業務。根據 0.1 節，這家 CDMO 需要識別自己在法規下的哪些角色？
blocks.en: A CDMO has taken on an outsourced sterilization business. According to clause 0.1, which roles under the regulations does this CDMO need to identify for itself?

blocks.zh: 概念解析：ISO 13485 vs. ISO 9001 的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: Key Differences Between ISO 13485 and ISO 9001

blocks.zh: 關鍵：符合 ISO 13485 不等於符合 ISO 9001；反之亦然。兩者是並行的獨立標準。
blocks.en: Key point: Conforming to ISO 13485 does not mean conforming to ISO 9001, and vice versa. They are parallel, independent standards.

blocks.zh: Clause 1: Scope — 適用範圍與排除條款
blocks.en: Clause 1: Scope — Applicability and Exclusions

blocks.zh: 概念解析：範圍聲明的核心目的
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: The Core Purpose of the Scope Statement

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 的 Scope 有一句關鍵語：組織需要「demonstrate its ability to provide… that consistently meet customer and applicable regulatory requirements」。
blocks.en: The Scope of ISO 13485 contains a key phrase: the organization needs to "demonstrate its ability to provide… that consistently meet customer and applicable regulatory requirements".

blocks.zh: 注意這三個關鍵詞：
blocks.en: Note these three keywords:

blocks.zh: demonstrate（展示）：QMS 不只是「有做」，還要能用文件和記錄證明
blocks.en: demonstrate: it is not enough for the QMS to "be done"; it must be proven with documents and records

blocks.zh: consistently（一致性）：不是偶爾符合，而是可重複、可預測的符合
blocks.en: consistently: not compliance now and then, but repeatable, predictable compliance

blocks.zh: applicable regulatory（適用法規）：不同市場有不同法規，需識別哪些適用
blocks.en: applicable regulatory: different markets have different regulations, and you need to identify which ones apply

blocks.zh: 重點提示：設計開發排除條款（Design & Development Exclusion）
blocks.en: Key Point: The Design and Development Exclusion

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 允許在特定條件下排除設計開發控制（Clause 7.3）——這對純製造型 CDMO 非常重要：
blocks.en: ISO 13485 allows design and development controls (Clause 7.3) to be excluded under certain conditions, which is very important for a pure manufacturing CDMO:

blocks.zh: 排除條件：適用法規允許此排除，且組織不從事設計開發活動
blocks.en: Conditions for exclusion: the applicable regulatory requirements permit the exclusion, and the organization does not carry out design and development activities

blocks.zh: 記錄要求：必須在質量手冊（4.2.2）中記錄排除的理由
blocks.en: Record requirement: the justification for the exclusion must be documented in the quality manual (4.2.2)

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：如果 CDMO 只負責生產/充填，由客戶擁有設計，則可在 QMS 範疇中合理排除 7.3——但必須有書面文件支撐此決定
blocks.en: CDMO practice: if a CDMO is responsible only for production/filling and the customer owns the design, it can reasonably exclude 7.3 from the QMS scope, but the decision must be supported by written documentation

blocks.zh: 稽核員不一定要求你做設計開發，但一定會要求你解釋為什麼排除。
blocks.en: An auditor will not necessarily require you to do design and development, but will always ask you to explain why it is excluded.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：外包流程的責任歸屬
blocks.en: Analogy: Who Is Responsible for Outsourced Processes

blocks.zh: 標準說「外包流程不執行，但仍是組織的責任」。這就像建商把水電工程發包給外包商——發包後不能甩手不管，建商（發包方）對最終成品仍要負責。
blocks.en: The standard says an outsourced process is not performed by the organization but remains the organization's responsibility. It is like a developer subcontracting the plumbing and electrical work: after awarding the contract you cannot walk away, and the developer (the party that outsourced) is still responsible for the finished building.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 語境中：若 CDMO 將滅菌外包給第三方滅菌廠，這個滅菌過程需納入 CDMO 的 QMS 監控架構（4.1.5 要求書面品質協議），稽核員會查看 CDMO 如何監控外包滅菌商。
blocks.en: In the CDMO context: if a CDMO outsources sterilization to a third-party sterilizer, that sterilization process must be brought into the CDMO's QMS monitoring framework (4.1.5 requires a written quality agreement), and the auditor will look at how the CDMO monitors the outsourced sterilizer.

blocks.zh: Clause 3: Terms and Definitions (3.1–3.10) — 核心術語（上）
blocks.en: Clause 3: Terms and Definitions (3.1–3.10) — Core Terms (Part 1)

blocks.zh: 概念解析：Advisory Notice（3.1）— 不只是召回通知
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: Advisory Notice (3.1) — More Than a Recall Notice

blocks.zh: Advisory Notice（忠告性通知）是一個比「召回」更廣泛的概念，涵蓋四種行動：
blocks.en: An Advisory Notice is a broader concept than a "recall" and covers four types of action:

blocks.zh: 使用上的補充說明（修改 IFU）
blocks.en: Supplementary information on use (modification of the IFU)

blocks.zh: 要求修改器械（如固件更新）
blocks.en: Modification of the device (e.g., a firmware update)

blocks.zh: 要求退回器械（實質召回）
blocks.en: Return of the device (effectively a recall)

blocks.zh: 要求銷毀器械
blocks.en: Destruction of the device

blocks.zh: 在 Post-Market Surveillance（上市後監控）中，當 CAPA 調查結果需要通知市場上的器械時，Advisory Notice 程序就啟動。FDA 的 Field Safety Corrective Action（FSCA）和歐盟 MDR 的 Field Safety Notice（FSN）本質上都屬於此類。
blocks.en: In post-market surveillance, the Advisory Notice procedure is triggered when the result of a CAPA investigation requires notifying devices already on the market. The FDA's Field Safety Corrective Action (FSCA) and the EU MDR's Field Safety Notice (FSN) both fall essentially into this category.

blocks.zh: 概念解析：Authorized Representative（3.2）— 歐盟 AR 的法規角色
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: Authorized Representative (3.2) — The Regulatory Role of the EU AR

blocks.zh: 歐盟 MDR 要求非歐盟製造商必須指定一名歐盟授權代表（EU AR），是 ISO 13485 術語 3.2 的直接實踐。
blocks.en: The EU MDR requires a non-EU manufacturer to appoint an EU authorized representative (EU AR), which is a direct implementation of ISO 13485 term 3.2.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言：若客戶是美國公司（非歐盟），要在歐盟銷售由 CDMO 代工生產的器械，客戶（製造商）必須有 EU AR。CDMO 通常不擔任此角色，但技術轉移文件中需確認 EU AR 的身份和授權文件。
blocks.en: For a CDMO: if the customer is a US company (non-EU) and wants to sell in the EU a device made by the CDMO, the customer (the manufacturer) must have an EU AR. The CDMO does not usually take on this role, but the identity and mandate documents of the EU AR should be confirmed in the technology transfer documentation.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Manufacturer（3.10）的法律責任邏輯
blocks.en: Key Point: The Legal Responsibility Logic of Manufacturer (3.10)

blocks.zh: 「Manufacturer」的定義有 7 條 Notes，核心概念是：
blocks.en: The definition of "Manufacturer" has 7 Notes, and the core concept is:

blocks.zh: Manufacturer = 在自己名義下提供器械的法律責任人——無論誰實際製造。
blocks.en: Manufacturer = the legally responsible person who makes a device available under their own name, regardless of who actually manufactures it.

blocks.zh: 這對 CDMO 非常重要：
blocks.en: This is very important for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: CDMO 為客戶代工 → 客戶是 Manufacturer，CDMO 是供應商
blocks.en: CDMO manufactures for a customer → the customer is the Manufacturer and the CDMO is a supplier

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 以自己品牌銷售代工產品 → CDMO 成為 Manufacturer，承擔全部法規責任
blocks.en: CDMO sells the contract-manufactured product under its own brand → the CDMO becomes the Manufacturer and bears full regulatory responsibility

blocks.zh: Note 5 警告：若 CDMO 修改了器械的預期用途並以自己名義銷售 → 自動成為 Manufacturer
blocks.en: Note 5 warns: if a CDMO changes the intended use of a device and sells it under its own name → it automatically becomes the Manufacturer

blocks.zh: 類比說明：Distributor（3.5）vs. 物流業者
blocks.en: Analogy: Distributor (3.5) vs. a Logistics Company

blocks.zh: Note 2 特別說明：代替製造商/進口商進行儲存和運輸的人，不算 Distributor。
blocks.en: Note 2 specifically states: a person who provides storage and transport on behalf of a manufacturer or importer is not a Distributor.

blocks.zh: 類比：超商的物流配送公司不是「經銷商」，超商才是。物流公司只是執行運輸任務，超商以自己名義銷售。
blocks.en: Analogy: the logistics company that delivers for a convenience store chain is not the "distributor"; the chain is. The logistics company only carries out the transport task, while the chain sells under its own name.

blocks.zh: 在醫療器械供應鏈中，這個區分影響 QMS 的適用範圍——純物流商不需要符合 ISO 13485 的 Distributor 要求，但必須符合相關倉儲/運輸法規。
blocks.en: In the medical device supply chain, this distinction affects the scope of the QMS: a pure logistics provider does not need to meet the Distributor requirements of ISO 13485, but must comply with the relevant storage/transport regulations.

blocks.zh: Clause 3: Terms and Definitions (3.11–3.20) — 核心術語（下）
blocks.en: Clause 3: Terms and Definitions (3.11–3.20) — Core Terms (Part 2)

blocks.zh: 概念解析：Medical Device（3.11）的核心區分原則
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: The Core Distinguishing Principle of Medical Device (3.11)

blocks.zh: 定義中最重要的一句話：「不通過藥理、免疫或代謝方式達到主要預期作用」——這是器械 vs. 藥品的法律分野。
blocks.en: The most important phrase in the definition: "does not achieve its primary intended action by pharmacological, immunological or metabolic means". This is the legal dividing line between a device and a medicinal product.

blocks.zh: 組合產品（Combination Products）的挑戰正在於此：
blocks.en: This is exactly where the challenge of combination products lies:

blocks.zh: 預充填注射器（PFS）+ 藥品 → 主要作用靠藥品（藥理）→ 通常歸類為藥品主導
blocks.en: Prefilled syringe (PFS) + drug → primary action is achieved by the drug (pharmacological) → usually classified as drug-led

blocks.zh: 藥物洗脫支架 → 支架（器械）+ 藥物 → 需確定主導作用 → 歸類可能是器械
blocks.en: Drug-eluting stent → stent (device) + drug → the primary mode of action must be determined → classification may be as a device

blocks.zh: 血糖計 → 通過物理測量提供信息 → 醫療器械
blocks.en: Blood glucose meter → provides information through physical measurement → medical device

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，客戶帶來的組合產品需要先確認監管分類，才能決定適用哪些法規要求。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, a combination product brought by a customer needs its regulatory classification confirmed first, before the applicable regulatory requirements can be determined.

blocks.zh: 概念解析：Medical Device Family（3.12）與 MDF 的關聯
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: Medical Device Family (3.12) and Its Link to the MDF

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 在 4.2.3 要求對每個醫療器械型號或器械系列建立和維護一個或多個「Medical Device File（MDF）」。
blocks.en: In 4.2.3, ISO 13485 requires the establishment and maintenance of one or more "Medical Device Files (MDF)" for each medical device type or medical device family.

blocks.zh: 「Medical Device Family」的定義直接影響 MDF 的數量：
blocks.en: The definition of "Medical Device Family" directly affects the number of MDFs:

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 生產同一客戶的 5 種規格注射器（相同基本設計、相同預期用途），這 5 種可歸為一個 family → 允許共用一個 MDF
blocks.en: If a CDMO makes syringes in 5 sizes for the same customer (same basic design, same intended use), the 5 can be grouped into one family, so a single MDF may be shared

blocks.zh: 若設計或預期用途不同（如注射器 vs. 輸液管），則需要獨立的 MDF
blocks.en: If the design or intended use differs (e.g., a syringe vs. an infusion set), separate MDFs are required

blocks.zh: 概念解析：Risk（3.17）— 與 ISO 9001 的重大差異
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: Risk (3.17) — A Major Difference from ISO 9001

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 採用 ISO 14971 的 Risk 定義（傷害發生機率 × 傷害嚴重性），而非 ISO 9001 的一般性風險思維。
blocks.en: ISO 13485 adopts the ISO 14971 definition of risk (the combination of the probability of occurrence of harm × the severity of that harm), rather than the general risk thinking of ISO 9001.

blocks.zh: 這一個術語的差異反映了兩個標準的本質不同：
blocks.en: This difference in a single term reflects the essentially different nature of the two standards:

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 的「risk」：商業風險、流程風險、機會管理
blocks.en: "Risk" in ISO 9001: business risk, process risk, opportunity management

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 的「risk」：患者安全、器械性能、法規合規性
blocks.en: "Risk" in ISO 13485: patient safety, device performance, regulatory compliance

blocks.zh: CDMO 在撰寫 FMEA 或 Risk Assessment 時，必須使用 ISO 14971 框架（severity × probability × detectability），而非 ISO 9001 的簡化風險矩陣。
blocks.en: When writing an FMEA or risk assessment, a CDMO must use the ISO 14971 framework (severity × probability × detectability), not the simplified risk matrix of ISO 9001.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Sterile Barrier System（3.19）對無菌製造的意義
blocks.en: Key Point: What the Sterile Barrier System (3.19) Means for Sterile Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 定義引用自 ISO 11607-1——這是「醫療器械無菌屏障系統最終滅菌包裝」的專門標準。
blocks.en: The definition is taken from ISO 11607-1, the dedicated standard for "packaging for terminally sterilized medical devices".

blocks.zh: Sterile Barrier System（SBS）是「防止微生物進入並允許在使用點進行無菌操作的最小包裝」。對無菌 CDMO 而言：
blocks.en: A Sterile Barrier System (SBS) is the "minimum package that prevents ingress of microorganisms and allows aseptic presentation of the contents at the point of use". For a sterile CDMO:

blocks.zh: PFS 的初級包裝（帶封蓋的注射器）= SBS
blocks.en: The primary packaging of a PFS (a syringe with closure) = SBS

blocks.zh: SBS 的完整性測試（包裝完整性驗證）= 7.5.7 的要求範疇
blocks.en: SBS integrity testing (package integrity validation) falls within the scope of the 7.5.7 requirements

blocks.zh: SBS 設計需符合 ISO 11607 系列，不在 ISO 13485 內規定，但 ISO 13485 的 7.5.7 要求有相關記錄
blocks.en: SBS design must comply with the ISO 11607 series, which is not specified within ISO 13485, but 7.5.7 of ISO 13485 requires the related records

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 同時生產三種預充填注射器（1 mL、2 mL、5 mL），規格不同但設計原理和預期用途相同。根據 3.12 的 medical device family 定義，這三種產品是否可以共用一個 Medical Device File？需要考慮哪些因素？
blocks.en: A CDMO makes three prefilled syringes at the same time (1 mL, 2 mL, 5 mL) with different sizes but the same design principle and intended use. According to the definition of medical device family in 3.12, can these three products share one Medical Device File? What factors need to be considered?

blocks.zh: Post-Market Surveillance（3.14）的定義要求「系統性地收集和分析上市後經驗」。在 CDMO 的 QMS 架構中，哪些數據來源可以作為 PMS 的輸入？CDMO 和品牌客戶之間如何分工？
blocks.en: The definition of Post-Market Surveillance (3.14) requires "systematically collecting and analyzing post-market experience". Within a CDMO's QMS, which data sources can serve as PMS inputs? How are responsibilities divided between the CDMO and the brand-owner customer?

blocks.zh: 一位同事說：「我們的 ERP 系統的 Risk Assessment 用的是 ISO 9001 的風險矩陣，ISO 13485 稽核應該也能接受。」根據 3.17 的定義和 ISO 13485 的整體架構，這個判斷是否有問題？
blocks.en: A colleague says: "The risk assessment in our ERP system uses the ISO 9001 risk matrix, so an ISO 13485 auditor should accept it too." Based on the definition in 3.17 and the overall architecture of ISO 13485, is this judgment a problem?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 是獨立標準，不是 ISO 9001 的子集：它刻意省略了「持續改進」要求，增加了醫療器械特定要求（MDF、Advisory Notice、無菌器械等）。符合 ISO 13485 不等於符合 ISO 9001。
blocks.en: ISO 13485 is an independent standard, not a subset of ISO 9001: it deliberately omits the "continual improvement" requirement and adds medical device-specific requirements (MDF, advisory notice, sterile devices, etc.). Conforming to ISO 13485 does not mean conforming to ISO 9001.

blocks.zh: 語言慣例至關重要：「shall」= 強制要求；「documented」= 建立+實施+維護三位一體；「as appropriate」= 默認適用除非能說明理由。
blocks.en: Language conventions are critical: "shall" = mandatory requirement; "documented" = established + implemented + maintained as one package; "as appropriate" = applies by default unless you can justify otherwise.

blocks.zh: 標準適用於整個供應鏈：從設計開發到服務提供，包括 CDMO、滅菌外包商、元件供應商，各方需識別自己的法規角色並整合進 QMS。
blocks.en: The standard applies across the entire supply chain: from design and development to service provision, including CDMOs, outsourced sterilizers and component suppliers; each party needs to identify its regulatory role and integrate it into the QMS.

blocks.zh: 20 個核心術語：特別注意 Manufacturer（法律責任人）、Advisory Notice（上市後行動的最廣義定義）、Risk（ISO 14971 框架，非一般商業風險）、Sterile Barrier System（ISO 11607 體系核心概念）。
blocks.en: 20 core terms: pay particular attention to Manufacturer (the legally responsible person), Advisory Notice (the broadest definition of post-market action), Risk (the ISO 14971 framework, not general business risk) and Sterile Barrier System (a core concept of the ISO 11607 system).

blocks.zh: 設計開發排除條款：純製造型 CDMO 可在合理情況下排除 Clause 7.3，但必須在 Quality Manual 中記錄理由並獲得法規認可。
blocks.en: Design and development exclusion: a pure manufacturing CDMO may exclude Clause 7.3 where justified, but the justification must be documented in the Quality Manual and accepted by the regulator.
